proposition: In 829/1426 Ibn Turka's enemies accused him a second time of ṣūfīgarī (Sufi bias); Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I was written after he was summoned to Herat to stand trial again.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Masdur I (829/1426, to Shahrukh's court)
mediation.note: MK reports this from the apology; the accusation is framed by the accused
